disclaimer: Closed-form screening only. Not FEA, CFD or coupled aeroelastic analysis. Kinematic Blender checks are separate.

min_flying_kg.note: one occupant, low fuel/energy; used for gust case

Ixx_body_kg_m2.note: box estimate m(w^2+h^2)/12 with w=2.0, h=1.0 m, +/-30%

VC_mps.note: 400 mph flight maximum target taken as design cruise/VMO

q_deploy_max_Pa.note: wing transit allowed only at q<=600 Pa (~31 m/s EAS); to be validated

n_neg_limit.note: CS-23 aerobatic negative limit (0.5 x positive)

rolling_asym_factor.note: CS-23.349 aerobatic: 100% one side, 60% other, at 2/3 n_limit

flutter_margin_on_VD.note: CS-23.629: free from flutter/divergence/reversal to 1.2 VD

prior_estimate.note: earlier project screen; kept for comparison

E_cap_Pa.note: 60/30/10 (0/+-45/90) laminate, classical lamination estimate from IM7/8552 ply data

strain_allow_ult.note: damage-tolerant (BVID, hot/wet) ultimate design strain; bounds 0.0030-0.0045

tau_allow_ult_Pa.note: web/skin ultimate shear allowable incl. stability by sandwich/stiffening

secondary_areal_kg_m2.note: ribs, sandwich cores, LE, TE, control surfaces, hinges, sealing, LPS per m^2 planform; set so panel mass agrees with Raymer GA statistical wing weight (see raymer_check)

pin_steel_Fsu_Pa.note: PH13-8Mo H1000 class, ~0.6 x Ftu 1517 MPa

ti_lug_notched_endurance_Pa.note: Kt~3, R=0.1, 1e7 cycles max stress; replace with MMPDS S-N for chosen form

pin_stiffness_N_per_m.note: pin + bushing + local lug radial stiffness per pin

cm0_section.note: NACA 64A2xx-class cambered section; CFD/polar to replace

x_cg_frac.note: section CG with mass-balanced control surfaces

Ch_delta_per_rad.note: sealed plain flap cf/c~0.28, no aero balance; bounds x0.7..x1.3

hinge_bound_factor.note: upper-bound multiplier used for actuator sizing

body_munk_volume_m3.note: MEASURED hull volume 4.35 m^3 x SYNTHETIC (k2-k1)=0.85

x_cg_candidates.note: no mass ledger yet; mid/rear-engine estimate -0.25
